scene_full.prompt: Bright, airy, light-filled photorealistic interior photograph of a contemporary luxury kitchen, U-shaped kitchen with peninsula. The hero is the countertop: Fantasy Brown marble (natural stone with flowing brown, cream and grey bands), 3cm thick, a high-gloss polished surface with a clean eased edge, shown in full with no cropped ends or corners. Forest green inset cabinets with matte black hardware, bright natural light from a skylight and tall windows. Light walls, styled minimally (a bowl of lemons, a small vase of greenery, a cutting board). Clean bright exposure, fresh and stunning, uncluttered, real materials and true-to-life reflections, eye-level architectural photography, 24-35mm lens, magazine quality. Tall vertical 9:16 composition: the stone surface sits in the vertical middle of the frame and spans no more than 85% of the width, with generous space above and below, so the image can also be cropped to 4:5 and 1:1 around it. Quiet, low-detail upper corners. No people, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
